opening: Maren kneels at the rim of the Tidewell, setting a fresh shell among the offerings. She looks up and smiles at you.

turns.action: I ask Maren how long she has tended the spring.
turns.narration: "Twenty years this winter." She turns her wrist so the silver scales catch the light. "It keeps a little of everyone who stays."

turns.action: I ask if the change ever frightens her.
turns.narration: Her laugh is warm, but her eyes drift to the water. "Not the scales. Some nights the tide calls louder than it used to."

turns.action: I promise to sit with her at the next high tide.
turns.narration: Maren is quiet for a moment. Then she presses a cool, webbed hand over yours. "I'd like that. Bring your own blanket. The stone gets cold."

choices: I ask Maren what the tide says when it calls.
I dip my fingers in the Tidewell.
I walk with Maren to the Salt Lantern.
